bible_quanes.question: Whose words open the book of Ecclesiastes?
bible_quanes.answer: The Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: Complete: "Vanity of vanities, ..."
What is there nothing of under the sun?
What abides while generations come and go?
What question does the Preacher ask about labour?
bible_quanes.answer: "What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?"

bible_quanes.question: What does the sun do?
bible_quanes.answer: Ariseth, goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose

bible_quanes.question: What do all the rivers do, though the sea is not full?
What comes with much wisdom?
How does the Preacher describe all the works done under the sun?
Over what was the Preacher king?
With what did the Preacher test his heart?
What did the Preacher find when he looked on all his works?
bible_quanes.answer: All was vanity and vexation of spirit

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say is nothing better for a man?
bible_quanes.answer: To eat and drink and enjoy the good of his labour
bible_quanes.explanation: This is from the hand of God.

bible_quanes.question: How does wisdom excel folly?
bible_quanes.answer: As far as light excelleth darkness

bible_quanes.question: What great works did the Preacher make?
What did the Preacher gather for himself?
What happens to the wise and the fool alike?
bible_quanes.answer: One event happeneth to them all

bible_quanes.question: Why did the Preacher hate his labour?
bible_quanes.answer: He should leave it unto the man that shall be after him
bible_quanes.explanation: Who may be wise or foolish.

bible_quanes.question: What is there no lasting remembrance of?
bible_quanes.answer: The wise man more than the fool

bible_quanes.question: What does God give to a man who is good in His sight?
Complete: "To every thing there is a season, ..."
bible_quanes.answer: A time for every purpose under heaven

bible_quanes.question: What is paired with "a time to be born"?
What has God made beautiful in its time?
bible_quanes.explanation: He has put eternity in their hearts.

bible_quanes.question: What is paired with "a time to weep"?
bible_quanes.explanation: And a time to mourn and a time to dance.

bible_quanes.question: What is paired with "a time to keep silence"?
What two pairs make up Ecclesiastes 3:8?
bible_quanes.answer: A time to love and a time to hate; a time of war and a time of peace

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say about whatever God does?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it

bible_quanes.question: To where do all go?
bible_quanes.answer: One place; all are of the dust and turn to dust again

bible_quanes.question: What is the gift of God, according to Ecclesiastes 3:13?
bible_quanes.answer: That every man should eat and drink and enjoy the good of his labour

bible_quanes.question: Whom will God judge?
bible_quanes.explanation: There is a time for every work.

bible_quanes.question: What is better than one?
bible_quanes.explanation: They have a good reward for their labour.

bible_quanes.question: What is not quickly broken?
What happens if one of two falls?
bible_quanes.answer: The one will lift up his fellow
bible_quanes.explanation: Woe to him who is alone.

bible_quanes.question: What is better than both hands full, with toil?
What did the Preacher consider?
bible_quanes.answer: All the oppression under the sun

bible_quanes.question: From what does the Preacher say all toil springs?
bible_quanes.answer: For this a man is envied of his neighbour

bible_quanes.question: Who is better than an old and foolish king?
bible_quanes.answer: A poor and a wise child

bible_quanes.question: What happens if two lie down together?
What is the condition of one who is alone without companion?
bible_quanes.answer: There is no end of his labour, neither is his eye satisfied with riches

bible_quanes.question: What will those who come afterward do?
With what should we not be rash before God?
bible_quanes.explanation: God is in heaven, and you on earth.

bible_quanes.question: What should we do when we make a vow to God?
bible_quanes.explanation: He has no pleasure in fools.

bible_quanes.question: What happens to the one who loves silver?
bible_quanes.answer: He will not be satisfied with silver

bible_quanes.question: How shall a man return, as he came from his mother's womb?
bible_quanes.explanation: He takes nothing from his labour.

bible_quanes.question: How should we walk when we go to the house of God?
bible_quanes.answer: Keep thy foot, and be more ready to hear

bible_quanes.question: What is better than to vow and not pay?
How is the sleep of a labouring man described?
bible_quanes.explanation: The abundance of the rich will not let him sleep.

bible_quanes.question: What is the gift of God, according to Ecclesiastes 5:19?
bible_quanes.answer: To be given riches and wealth and power to eat thereof

bible_quanes.question: How does a dream come?
bible_quanes.explanation: And a fool's voice by many words.

bible_quanes.question: What severe evil has the Preacher seen?
bible_quanes.answer: Riches kept for their owner to his hurt

bible_quanes.question: What does God sometimes not give a man to whom He gives riches?
For what is all the labour of man?
bible_quanes.explanation: Yet the soul is not satisfied.

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher ask in Ecclesiastes 6:12?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who knoweth what is good for man in this life?"

bible_quanes.question: What is better than the wandering of desire?
What does the Preacher say is better than a man with a hundred children who is not satisfied?
Where do all go, even if a man lives a thousand years twice?
With whom can man not contend?
bible_quanes.answer: Him who is mightier than he

bible_quanes.question: To what are the days of a man's life compared?
What do many words increase?
Where is the evil seen that is common among men?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Preacher describes an evil he has seen under the sun.

bible_quanes.question: What is a good name better than?
bible_quanes.explanation: And the day of death than the day of birth.

bible_quanes.question: What is better than the beginning of a thing?
bible_quanes.explanation: The patient is better than the proud.

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say about a just man on earth?
bible_quanes.answer: Not a just man upon earth that doeth good and sinneth not

bible_quanes.question: Why should we not hasten to be angry?
bible_quanes.answer: For anger resteth in the bosom of fools

bible_quanes.question: Where is it better to go than to the house of feasting?
bible_quanes.explanation: It makes us consider our end.

bible_quanes.question: What should we not say?
bible_quanes.answer: "Why were the former days better than these?"
bible_quanes.explanation: It is not wise to ask this.

bible_quanes.question: What should we do in the day of prosperity and adversity?
bible_quanes.answer: Be joyful in prosperity; consider in adversity

bible_quanes.question: How did God make man?
bible_quanes.explanation: But they sought out many schemes.

bible_quanes.question: To what is the laughter of the fool compared?
bible_quanes.answer: The crackling of thorns under a pot

bible_quanes.question: What does wisdom provide, like money?
bible_quanes.explanation: Wisdom gives life to those who have it.

bible_quanes.question: What does a man's wisdom do to his face?
bible_quanes.explanation: The sternness of his face is changed.

bible_quanes.question: Over what does no one have power?
bible_quanes.answer: The spirit, and the day of death

bible_quanes.question: What happens when a sentence against evil is not executed speedily?
bible_quanes.answer: The heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil

bible_quanes.question: What did the Preacher commend?
bible_quanes.answer: Mirth: to eat, to drink and to be merry

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say to keep?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the sake of your oath to God.

bible_quanes.question: What does a wise man's heart discern?
With whom will it be well?
What can man not find out?
bible_quanes.answer: The work that is done under the sun

bible_quanes.question: What vanity does the Preacher describe in Ecclesiastes 8:14?
bible_quanes.answer: Just men unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say about the word of a king?
bible_quanes.answer: There is power, and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

bible_quanes.question: What is better than a dead lion?
bible_quanes.explanation: While there is life there is hope.

bible_quanes.question: How should we do whatever our hand finds to do?
bible_quanes.explanation: There is no work in the grave.

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say about the race and the battle?
bible_quanes.answer: The race is not to the swift nor the battle to the strong; time and chance happen to them all

bible_quanes.question: How should we eat our bread?
bible_quanes.explanation: And drink wine with a merry heart.

bible_quanes.question: What do the living know?
With whom are we told to live joyfully?
bible_quanes.explanation: All the days of your vain life.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the poor wise man who delivered the city?
Though wisdom is better than strength, what happens to the poor man's wisdom?
bible_quanes.explanation: And his words are not heard.

bible_quanes.question: What can one sinner destroy?
bible_quanes.explanation: Wisdom is better than weapons of war.

bible_quanes.question: To what are men compared when evil time falls suddenly on them?
bible_quanes.answer: Fish taken in a net and birds caught in a snare

bible_quanes.question: What do dead flies do to the perfumer's ointment?
bible_quanes.answer: Cause it to send forth a stinking savour
bible_quanes.explanation: So a little folly spoils wisdom.

bible_quanes.question: What happens to the one who digs a pit?
Why should we not curse the king, even in thought?
bible_quanes.answer: A bird of the air may carry the voice

bible_quanes.question: What happens because of laziness?
Where is a wise man's heart?
bible_quanes.explanation: But a fool's at his left.

bible_quanes.question: What must one do if the axe is dull?
Woe to the land whose king is what?
bible_quanes.explanation: And whose princes feast in the morning.

bible_quanes.question: What does money answer, according to Ecclesiastes 10:19?
What is a serpent that bites before being charmed like?
What are the words of a wise man's mouth?
bible_quanes.explanation: But the lips of a fool swallow him up.

bible_quanes.question: What should we cast on the waters?
bible_quanes.explanation: We will find it after many days.

bible_quanes.question: What should a young man know as he rejoices in his youth?
bible_quanes.answer: God will bring him into judgment for all these things

bible_quanes.question: To how many should we give a serving?
bible_quanes.explanation: For we do not know what evil may come.

bible_quanes.question: What will the one who observes the wind not do?
bible_quanes.explanation: And he who regards the clouds will not reap.

bible_quanes.question: What do we not know, just as we do not know the way of the wind?
bible_quanes.answer: The works of God who maketh all

bible_quanes.question: What should we do in the morning and evening?
bible_quanes.answer: Sow our seed in the morning and not withhold our hand in the evening

bible_quanes.question: How is the light described?
bible_quanes.explanation: It is pleasant to see the sun.

bible_quanes.question: What are childhood and youth?
What happens where a tree falls?
What should a man remember even if he lives many years?
bible_quanes.answer: The days of darkness, for they will be many

bible_quanes.question: When should we remember our Creator?
bible_quanes.answer: In the days of our youth

bible_quanes.question: What is the conclusion of the whole matter?
bible_quanes.answer: Fear God and keep His commandments

bible_quanes.question: What happens to the spirit when the dust returns to the earth?
bible_quanes.answer: The spirit shall return unto God who gave it

bible_quanes.question: Into what will God bring every work?
Why do the grinders cease in old age?
What images describe death in Ecclesiastes 12:6?
bible_quanes.answer: The silver cord loosed and the golden bowl broken

bible_quanes.question: To what are the words of the wise compared?
bible_quanes.answer: Goads, and nails fastened by the masters of assemblies

bible_quanes.question: What does the Preacher say about making many books?
bible_quanes.explanation: And much study wearies the flesh.

bible_quanes.question: What shall flourish, in Ecclesiastes 12:5?
bible_quanes.explanation: The almond tree flourishing is part of the Preacher's picture of old age.

bible_quanes.question: What phrase is repeated near the end of Ecclesiastes?
